name: Yolanda Davidson
office: City of Inglewood, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Yolanda Davidson is a small business owner. She founded Press for Justice, which advocates for victims and families. She completed the Los Angeles African American Women’s Public Policy Institute and California Black Women’s Collective programs. She also graduated from the Congressional Black Caucus Institute. She pledges to demand more visible law enforcement, audit traffic, and reduce the aviation noise insulation backlog. She supports strengthening affordable housing requirements in new projects. She wants to streamline rent stabilization for clearer guidance and enforcement. She has urged that police wear body cameras by the 2028 Olympics. She calls for ending short afternoon council meetings and informing the public about large city deals beforehand.
